items.mainDefect: The remote-download limit is hardcoded to 10 MB instead of respecting the configured upload limit, potentially truncating permitted larger images.

secondary.defect: The downsizing loop ignores downsize's false return value, retrying failed conversions and passing the corrupt file to Upload.create_for.
The URL-upload branch never sets content_type, leaving it nil when the file reaches Upload.create_for.
